sample_prescriptions_for_rank1_venus.remedy_label_human: Recite the Venus beej mantra 'Om Draam Dreem Draum Sah Shukraya Namah' 108 times daily on Friday, facing east.
Chant Shukra Ashtottara Shatanamavali 108 times on Fridays. Venus governs love, beauty, relationships, and luxury.
